Those affected include the flagged content creators, minor users of the platform, readers exposed to the ranked feed. Within that group, the affected people cannot afford the time or money that any appeal would require. Consent was obtained from the affected adults. If the agent's recommendation is followed, the most plausible consequence is wrongful denial of a benefit the person was entitled to, materialising within several months.
